blocking_findings.title: Canon实际Owner/Worker租约未核验
blocking_findings.evidence: Current Canon is checked for revision and one WIP scope link, but OW binding/lease records and CP workers are never inspected. Standalone Owner/Worker refs can satisfy the gate even when Canon has no registrations, duplicate conflicting workers, or documents marked expired.
blocking_findings.fix: Bind and validate exact active Canon Owner lease and CP Worker records for the scope, task, route/output path and actor, including uniqueness and no conflicting active ownership. Retain Owner.selected_worker_id -> Worker.selected_owner_ref acyclic order.

blocking_findings.title: 独审决定未与本次Source四个精确ref及身份闭合
blocking_findings.evidence: The review gate reads reviewer_id/decision/formal_acceptance only. It neither validates schema/actor_role nor requires reviewer equality with scope.source_reviewer nor binds source_hdf_ref/source_mf_ref/caller_ref/root_contract_ref. The requested actor_id decision schema without legacy reviewer_id is rejected, while a three-field unrelated review is accepted.
blocking_findings.fix: Specify a single independent decision schema and consume actor_id/actor_role plus SourceAcceptedonly/noactualorformal; require non-author identity equality across scope and decision, and exact HDF/MF/caller/root-contract refs. Include the root contract in held refs and reconcile it with HDF/MF, rather than only checking caller bytes.

blocking_findings.title: Scope禁止未来vector/request字段只写在合同中
blocking_findings.evidence: root_request accepts additional scope.current_canonical_vector_ref and scope.future_request_sha256 fields although contract line29 explicitly excludes current CP370 vector/proof/future request to avoid a reference cycle. before_canonical_revisions is also not checked.
blocking_findings.fix: Enforce a precise Scope schema or reject forbidden forward-reference fields and validate historical revision declarations. Keep actual_registration_proof_ref and current vector exclusively in the post-registration request.
